title: SearchDocumentWriteRequest
description: search.document-write-request@1: the request of search.document.write on OpenVibe.Search (a service writes and reads only the documents it owns). PUT /api/v1/documents/:owner/:type/:id: a search.index-document@1 (owner, type and id come from the path; a body that names others is 422). DELETE /api/v1/documents/:owner/:type/:id?revision= (a tombstone) and the owner reads (GET /api/v1/owners/:owner/documents, …/documents/:type/:id, …/rejections) take no body.
